{{Top|leg}}
'''Security Master''' was a position on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]]. The [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|Security]] Master had access to all of the information sources of Arkania, and was able to control the flow of information into and out of the small community. As a general rule, whoever held the position was to have the best interests of the people at heart; even if the motivations were occasionally unclear.<ref name="ac">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030206arkanianintro|text=Arkanian Chill|int=Arkanian Chill}}</ref>

[[Hyrim Focela]] once served as the Security Master.<ref name="ac" />
